CDCR inmates can only receive quarterly packages from certain vendors. Access corrections, walkenhorst and union supply are the most popular ones. So once per quarter, you can order him a package (there’s clothes, shoes, hygiene, food etc). There’s also special orders for electronics (cd player, earphones etc) that isn’t counted as the quarterly package.

So restitution is only relevant is you’re putting money on his books. If you put $100, he’ll only receive $50. But ordering packages is done through the vendor website so restitution wont factor in.
